checklist.detail: codex --version reported codex-cli 0.149.1 immediately before the isolated run.
The real PtyConfig launch emitted --yolo; root, follow-up, and resumed rollout contexts recorded approval_policy=never and danger-full-access.
The real launch emitted --model gpt-5.6-terra and -c model_reasoning_effort=xhigh; all three recorded turn contexts retained that model and effort.
Worker developer_instructions and startup workflow loaded; the startup turn called the expected coordination and task lifecycle tools.
The production argv emitted --no-alt-screen and every recorded turn context used the isolated repository cwd.
The initialized disposable CAS_ROOT served mcp__cs tools before the root lifecycle turn; the startup turn called coordination whoami and task mine.
A later injected turn called coordination whoami and task mine again through the same production PTY and isolated CAS store.
The follow-up used Codex's code-mode exec tool in the same turn as directly exposed cs coordination/task tools; production argv retained code mode.
The isolated worker loaded unique AGENTS.md, .codex skill, and .codex agent markers; the deterministic launch parity gate covers the synced Codex catalogs.
Production config assertions covered CAS role/factory/session/model/effort environment, CAS_ROOT, and Codex worker metadata; the real server used the disposable initialized root.
The real production matrix completed Mux interrupt-and-inject recovery under --yolo and the redirected resumed turn completed with the expected marker.
PtyConfig emitted no rollout budget override, and all three real Codex turns completed without a rollout-token-budget abort.
Non-gating probe accepted -c model_reasoning_effort=max: codex -c model_reasoning_effort=max --version exited 0 and reported codex-cli 0.149.1.

evidence.summary: Fresh real Codex 0.149.1 PtyConfig::codex run with target/debug/cas first on PATH, initialized disposable CAS_ROOT, and disposable project fixtures; the guarded live matrix passed with 1 test passed in 53.76s.
The live probe initializes the disposable project with the current target/debug/cas before Codex starts, so the restricted MCP subprocess has a current-schema CAS_ROOT.
Codex 0.149.1 accepted the max effort TOML override at CLI parse time and exited 0; this result is non-gating and does not alter Cassy's Effort vocabulary.
The guarded parity integration target passed both tests, covering Codex catalogs, role instructions, launch args, effective contract, and MCP prefix.
